Name: Pado Swakatoon
Description: Pado is a street smart young transgender man, caught caught up with many problems. One, being mistaken for being female a lot. Pado soon finds himself a worthwhile partner with Eel O'Brien, a strip club bouncer being encouraged to go straight by the semi-positive life he is building for himself. Eel's life goes sideways when he gains super powers and super-powered enemies. This puts Pado in the crosshairs, literally, as the enemies understand they can manipulate Eel by threatening Pado.
